generationPrompts.prompt: Use case: professional logo variant artwork. On ONE truly transparent canvas place TWO separated versions of the SAME compact emblem, equal sized, side by side with a wide empty transparent gap. NO WORDS ANYWHERE. The LEFT emblem should faithfully adapt the provided dealer logo using its angular interwoven double A and plane motif. Keep the distinctive AA geometry, shorten the long underline to the emblem width, use a darker flat gold #916b18 so it is visible on white. The RIGHT emblem must repeat EXACTLY the same geometry in one uniform medium-light grey #b9bec2, with all counters completely transparent. No pure white ink at all. Each emblem must be approximately square with substantial strokes, clean vector-like boundaries and all negative spaces transparent. No background, no label, no text, no shadow, no gradient, no glow, no texture, no distressed edges, no tiny lines, no mockup. Both emblems should be crisp, beautifully balanced, and legible at 32 pixels. Fit each entire symbol within its own square half of a 2:1 canvas, margins around each and clear central gap.
